description: This Python module provides functions for extracting and parsing text content from various file formats such as TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX. It includes utilities to extract text bytes from files, summarize content previews, and parse JSON files (including standard JSON, NDJSON, and nested structures) into semantic documents with rich metadata.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts readable text from a file given its filename and raw bytes, supporting TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX formats.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decodes byte content as UTF-8 ignoring errors for text files.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text content from PDF bytes using pdfminer.six.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from DOCX bytes, including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str _extract_xlsx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from XLSX bytes, including sheet names and cell values.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Creates a compact preview of extracted text for UI confirmation, limiting to a specified number of characters.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] parse_json_documents(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Parses JSON content into semantic documents, handling objects, arrays, and NDJSON formats with recursive flattening and rich metadata.

methods.name: str _decode_utf8(data: bytes)
methods.description: Decodes bytes into UTF-8 string, removing BOM.

methods.name: str _collapse_ws(value: str)
methods.description: Collapses whitespace in text while preserving newlines.

methods.name: str _sanitize_value(val: Any, max_len: int = 2000)
methods.description: Sanitizes primitive values into readable, length-limited strings.

methods.name: bool _looks_short_primitive_list(lst: List[Any], max_items: int = 12)
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a list contains only short primitive items.

methods.name: Optional[str] _find_record_id(obj: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Attempts to extract a representative identifier from common record fields.

methods.name: Tuple[str,List[str]] _obj_to_text( obj: Dict[str, Any], base_path: str = "$", max_field_value_len: int = 2000, max_total_len: int = 20000, )
methods.description: Converts an object into a human-readable text block, including primitive fields and small lists.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _collect_docs( node: Any, path: str, structure: str, filename: str, line_index: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Recursively collects and flattens dictionaries and lists into structured documents with metadata.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[Any],Optional[str]] _parse_as_json(text: str)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string as generic JSON, returning the object or error.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Any],List[int]] _parse_as_ndjson(text: str)
methods.description: Parses text into NDJSON records, returning list of objects and line indices.
